title: Non-intrusive appliance state detection in unseen homes using classical machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.00920v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) infers, from the aggregate signal of a single smart meter, when each appliance in a home is ON or OFF, offering significant potential to enhance energy efficiency. Classical machine-learning detectors report F1 scores (the harmonic mean of precision and recall) from 0.53 to 0.98, but the causes of this spread are unseparated, so it is unclear which design choices matter. Real-world deployments, however, require detectors that work in houses never seen during training, whereas most studies test on houses used for training. To address this challenge, we propose a factorial analysis of variance design that separates the effects of classifier, feature set and class-imbalance strategy across five appliances (270 configurations), and a leave-house-out protocol with house-grouped model selection. translated_title: 基于经典机器学习的未见家庭非侵入式电器状态检测
translated_abstract: 非侵入式负载监测（NILM）通过单个智能电表的总体信号推断家庭中每个电器何时处于开启或关闭状态，在提升能源效率方面具有巨大潜力。经典机器学习检测器报告的F1分数（精确率与召回率的调和平均值）在0.53到0.98之间，但这种差异的原因尚未被分离，因此不清楚哪些设计选择真正重要。然而，现实世界的部署要求检测器能够在训练时从未见过的房屋中工作，而大多数研究是在用于训练的房屋上进行测试。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种方差因子分析设计，在五种电器（270种配置）上分离分类器、特征集和类别不平衡策略的影响，并采用留出房屋协议与按房屋分组的模型选择。与一次只改变一个因素或将房屋混合研究的方法不同，该方法能够将性能归因于每个因素。
tldr: 该论文提出方差因子分析设计与留出房屋验证协议，以分离分类器、特征集和类别不平衡策略对NILM检测器性能的影响，并实现检测器在未见过的家庭中的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a factorial ANOVA design combined with a leave-house-out protocol to disentangle the effects of classifier, feature set, and class-imbalance strategy on NILM detector performance, enabling generalization to unseen homes.
